name: Kyiv, Ukraine
summary: Kyiv was Russia's first objective of the invasion. Troops advancing from Belarus reached the northern suburbs in February 2022 but failed to take the city and withdrew on 2 April, leaving mass killings of civilians behind them in Bucha and Irpin. The capital has faced no ground threat since, but is struck regularly by missiles and drones.
